messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick sync for BrightQuill private deploy week1. Need to close KMS/IAM/audit items before cutover. Customer requires 365d audit retention and quarterly KMS rotation evidence. Any blockers?
Liam (CSE): Preflight done. CIDR 10.20.0.0/22 allocated; they asked for an extra /28 for management. Need NAT details and confirmation of Splunk egress path.
Priya (SRE): We need their subnet map. They want split egress: Splunk over VPC peering, other traffic via NAT. Peering is up on our side but awaiting their reciprocal route. Asked them to open TCP/4503 to splunk.company.net.
Rohit (Security): KMS approach: customer-managed CMK in BrightQuill AWS account, Redwood cross-account access. I'll provide a key policy template and KMS grant flow. For retention: CloudTrail -> S3 with 365d lifecycle + signed export for rotation events.
Aisha (CS): @Rohit please paste a short key policy snippet we can send.
Rohit (Security): Snippet (replace ARNs): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::BRIGHT:role/RedwoodKMSUser"},"Action":"kms:*","Resource":"*"}]}`. Enable automatic rotation and add CloudTrail read.
NetworkBot: Route table RTB-08 applied to subnet-priv-01, NAT gateway ngw-03 created (us-east-1b) :white_check_mark:
Liam (CSE): IAM note: need cross-account role RedwoodProvisioner with sts:AssumeRole and s3:PutObject to a specific prefix. Share assume-role policy to test.
Jenna (Account Exec): Renewal ~90 days. This deployment is expansion motion; if we meet SLA & observability by week2 I can push renewal +25%. Audit evidence delay is the main risk.
Aisha (CS): Action items: Priya confirm peering route status; Rohit finalize key policy + rotation evidence template; Liam validate IAM role trust & test prefix; Jenna flag renewal timeline with legal. I'll consolidate and send to BrightQuill.
Priya (SRE): Confirmed peering route on our side to 10.20.0.0/22 -> peering-bridge. Waiting on BrightQuill to push reciprocal route and provide their route table ID.
Rohit (Security): I'll prepare rotation evidence package (CloudTrail query export + signed verification PDF in S3, presigned URL 30d). ETA EOD.
BrightQuill (Customer): Thx, will share route table today and role ARN. Can rotation evidence be a PDF?
Rohit (Security): Yes, we'll export and package as PDF with signed statement and provide presigned URL.
OpsBot: Deployment dry-run started at 2024-04-01T15:12:30Z, step 3/6 succeeded (kv cache warmup); peering-status: pending.
Aisha (CS): I'll send the consolidated note now. Next sync Tuesday 11am ET. Closing thread once BrightQuill confirms route + ARN. :white_check_mark:
